name: Pearl Occasion
description: Cream ranunculus, ivory garden roses and delicate white sweet peas in a rounded, polished composition. Classic, luminous and graceful. A refined wedding gift or a soft celebration of a special anniversary.

name: The Lavender Letter
description: Fragrant lavender, lilac flowers and rosemary in a loosely gathered cottage-garden posy. Purple, aromatic and nostalgic. For a gardener who loves herbs, quiet afternoons and an informal birthday gesture.

name: Coral Crush
description: Coral ranunculus, peach roses and lively spring greenery. Fresh, playful and expressive, with bright warm petals. For a joyful celebration, a friend's birthday or an optimistic new beginning.

name: Red Velvet
description: Deep red roses with dark green foliage in a compact velvet-toned arrangement. Passionate, timeless and unmistakably romantic. For an intimate anniversary or a heartfelt declaration of affection.

name: First Light
description: Golden sunflowers and yellow daisies in a bright, generous bouquet. Sunny, optimistic and full of energy. For a graduation, a proud achievement or congratulations to someone beginning their next chapter.

name: Blue Sunday
description: Blue delphinium, forget-me-nots and airy white flowers. Cool, delicate and serene, with a relaxed garden silhouette. For a peaceful just-because gesture or someone who loves a soft blue palette.

name: An Orchid Study
description: White phalaenopsis orchids with a few sculptural green leaves in a low, considered arrangement. Quiet luxury, smooth curves and restrained detail. A contemporary housewarming gift for a minimalist home.

name: Amber Evening
description: Bronze chrysanthemums, copper dahlias and textured autumn foliage. Warm, layered and earthy, with the richness of amber and burnt orange. For an autumn dinner invitation or a thoughtful seasonal thank-you.

name: A Meadow Note
description: Small summer wildflowers, daisies and light green stems gathered into an informal hand-tied posy. Unfussy, outdoorsy and fresh. A sweet picnic birthday gesture for someone who prefers nature to formality.

name: Winter Whisper
description: White amaryllis, silver-toned branches and crisp winter greenery. Clean, luminous and quietly seasonal. A graceful winter gift with an elegant white palette and a little architectural height.

name: A Soft Arrival
description: Pale pink roses, soft cream lisianthus and tender pastel accents in a small rounded bouquet. Gentle, welcoming and affectionate. A quiet celebration of a new baby or a warm welcome to a growing family.

name: Peach Welcome
description: Peach garden roses and apricot flowers with relaxed greenery. Inviting, warm and easy to live with. A friendly housewarming gesture or a thoughtful bouquet for someone settling into a new home.

name: The Saffron Moment
description: Saffron marigolds, golden flowers and generous green leaves in an abundant warm-colored composition. Festive, radiant and exuberant. For a colorful celebration or a joyful gathering around a table.

name: Velvet Rose
description: Plum roses, dusky mauve flowers and soft blush layers. Romantic but not traditional, with a poetic, faded-velvet palette. An intimate gesture for someone who loves vintage textures and understated drama.

name: An Apricot Toast
description: Apricot ranunculus, peach roses and warm cream flowers arranged with a light, celebratory rhythm. Joyful, tender and sophisticated. For an engagement, a happy announcement or a small milestone worth toasting.

name: Moon Song
description: Pure white lisianthus, delicate star-shaped flowers and restrained greenery. Peaceful, soft and contemplative. A sensitive remembrance bouquet or a quiet expression of support, without bright colors or dramatic contrasts.

name: Night Garden
description: Purple dahlias, burgundy flowers and dark foliage in an expressive asymmetric silhouette. Bold, artistic and a little mysterious. For an evening celebration or a creative person who loves deep, unusual colors.

name: Thank You, In Green
description: Fresh white tulips and crisp green foliage in a neat, medium-sized arrangement. Considered, professional and quietly appreciative. An elegant thank-you for a colleague, mentor or generous host.

name: Pink Reverie
description: Soft pink tulips, a little cream and clean green stems. Simple, sweet and quietly romantic, with a light spring feeling. A tender first-anniversary gesture or an uncomplicated expression of affection.

name: Garden Party
description: A generous mix of pink roses, cream ranunculus and airy garden flowers. Abundant, joyful and relaxed rather than formal. For a lively birthday party, a welcoming host or a colorful gathering of friends.

name: Sunday Brunch
description: Blush peonies, pale hydrangea and soft greenery in an open, comfortable composition. Friendly, generous and easygoing. A casual brunch invitation, a weekend visit or a lovely gesture for a close friend.

name: Citrus Muse
description: Lemon-yellow gerbera, orange flowers and vivid green accents. Punchy, playful and full of personality. For someone who loves bold color, a cheerful birthday or an energetic celebration.

name: Blue Hour
description: Blue hydrangea, indigo iris and cool white accents. Moody, sophisticated and calm, like twilight by the water. For a design-conscious recipient who prefers a rich blue palette to pink or red.

name: A Rosy Chapter
description: Dusty rose flowers, pale anemones and a little soft foliage. Reflective, gentle and romantic without being grand. A thoughtful gift for a book lover, a quiet birthday or the beginning of a new chapter.

name: The White Room
description: White hydrangea and ivory flowers in a low, monochrome composition with clean edges. Minimal, serene and quietly substantial. For a contemporary interior, a new office or someone who loves a restrained white palette.

name: Petit Merci
description: A petite posy of cream freesia and small white flowers with a touch of greenery. Delicate, lightly fragrant and modest in scale. A little thank-you or a simple beautiful gesture rather than a grand statement.

name: The Grand Gesture
description: An abundant arrangement of long-stemmed red roses with polished dark greenery. Large, luxurious and openly romantic. For a major anniversary or an important celebration where a small bouquet would not say enough.

name: Wine Poetry
description: Burgundy tulips, plum lisianthus and expressive green lines. Rich, lyrical and quietly dramatic, with a wine-colored palette. An elegant dinner-party gift or a romantic evening gesture with unusual texture.

name: The Orchid Column
description: Tall white phalaenopsis orchid stems arranged vertically with minimal green leaves. Architectural, formal and sculptural, with an elegant sense of height. For a grand entrance, a professional celebration or a contemporary space.

name: Green Architecture
description: A monochrome arrangement of tropical monstera leaves, palm fronds and sculptural green foliage, without colorful flowers. Strong, graphic and modern. For an office opening or a recipient who wants an all-green architectural display.

name: Buttercup Day
description: Buttery yellow ranunculus, small golden flowers and light greenery in a cheerful petite bouquet. Sweet, sunny and uncomplicated. A just-because surprise or a little encouragement for someone who loves yellow.

name: Sea Glass
description: Mint-toned greenery, white hydrangea and pale cream accents in a soft airy composition. Fresh, coastal and tranquil, with a sea-glass palette. For a relaxed new home or a calm, understated birthday gesture.

name: An Autumn Letter
description: Russet flowers, copper-toned blooms and eucalyptus with textured seasonal stems. Warm, natural and reflective. A heartfelt autumn thank-you or a thoughtful gesture for someone who loves earthy, muted colors.

name: Blush Nocturne
description: Blush roses, chocolate cosmos and a few deep wine accents. Intimate, velvety and expressive, balancing softness with a little darkness. For a romantic anniversary evening or someone who loves a subtle baroque mood.
